what_works: The centered modal with a clear dropdown and confirm button guides the user efficiently without visual clutter.
The hero image with a subtle overlay adds depth while keeping attention on the product category tiles below.
Each category tile uses a distinct background color and clear label, creating strong visual hierarchy and easy navigation.
Consistent spacing (4‑10 px) and rounded corners produce a cohesive, uncluttered layout.
Typography hierarchy with Akkurat Mono and Geograph ensures readability and a contemporary feel.
